purpose: Reusable opening-line patterns for the first 8-15 seconds, to replace generic openings like 'Today we will learn...' — see COMPETITOR_STRATEGY.md Step 5 (opening hook discipline) and rubric.md dimension 9.

hooks.pattern: Have you ever lost something you really loved?
hooks.use_when: conflict is about loss or a missing item
conflict opens in-scene rather than as a question

hooks.pattern: What would you do if your best friend needed your help right now?

hooks.use_when: conflict is about honesty or a mistake

hooks.pattern: Something exciting was about to happen at [environment]...
hooks.use_when: conflict opens with anticipation, e.g. a trip or new friend

hooks.pattern: It was the darkest, quietest night [character] had ever seen...
hooks.use_when: conflict is about fear or nighttime

metadata.rule: Never repeat the same hook_id in two consecutive episodes — check world_state.json episode_chronology before selecting.
